objectives.statement: Decide whether a sentence needs det er or det finnes from its meaning.
Use det er to identify, describe, give time, and name days.
Use det finnes to say that something exists or is available.

notes: Must contrast identification/description det er with existence/availability det finnes, and cover simple impersonal det for weather/time (det regner, det er onsdag). Keep examples concrete and Bokmål.
